newsitem.title: USA: Ohio unemployment rate falls to 4.2 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Ohio unemployment rate falls to 4.2 pct in June.

text.p: Ohio's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate fell to 4.2 percent in June from 4.6 percent in May and 4.9 percent a year ago, the state employment services bureau reported Friday.
"The drop in the unemployment rate in June is further evidence of the strength of the Ohio labor market," bureau Director Debra Bowland said in a statement.
Total employment reached an all-time high of nearly 5.5 million, with an increase of 127,000 jobs since June 1996, the bureau reported.
Nonfarm payroll employment rose 4,000 jobs in June over the previous month while employment in goods producing industries declined by 1,000 jobs in June.
Ohio continues to run below the national unemployment rate, which rose to 5 percent in June from 4.8 percent in May.
